methodology: Each idea rated: skill_match(0-10), infra_reuse(0-10), hackathon_fit(0-10), prize_alignment(0-10). Score = avg * 10.

ideas.title: Domain Reputation Score Endpoint
ideas.brief: Add /reputation endpoint aggregating WHOIS+DMARC+SSL+DNS into trust score. $0.005/call via x402.

ideas.title: Agent Score Endpoint
ideas.brief: /agent-score probes MCP tools, measures quality, checks evidence trails. $0.01/call.

ideas.title: Content Authenticity Endpoint
ideas.brief: /authenticity checks AI text (noslop) + C2PA images + live links. $0.005/call.

ideas.title: API Health Monitor
ideas.brief: /health checks uptime, latency, TLS, CORS, rate limits. $0.003/call.

ideas.title: Composite Dashboard
ideas.brief: Bundle all endpoints under one payTo. Analytics + leaderboard tracking. Factory auto-deploys new endpoints.

ideas.title: Telegraph Miner AI Detector
ideas.brief: Wrap noslop as Telegraph Miner for AI text detection intent. Scored 0-100. Application Track entry.

ideas.title: Slop Repair Agent
ideas.brief: Diagnose slop patterns (NARR/NEG/3LIST/CLICHE/FLAT) and rewrite. MCP tool for agents.

ideas.title: X Post Verification Bot
ideas.brief: TruthWire: verify X posts for AI content + scams. Auto-reply with status. Drives Telegraph X engagement (25% of score).

ideas.title: Cancel-as-a-Service x402 API
ideas.brief: Expose cancelme routes as x402-gated API. $0.01/route. Already has MCP server.

ideas.title: Subscription Cost Optimizer
ideas.brief: Agent scans subscriptions, finds cheaper alternatives, generates escape routes. cancelme+dealradar+llmdeals.

ideas.title: Proof-of-Cancellation Certificate
ideas.brief: SHA-256 signed receipt with evidence. Proof-carrying pattern from dell2.

ideas.title: Deal Verification MCP
ideas.brief: Verification kernel as MCP tool. verify(url) returns 11-dimension proof certificate.

ideas.title: Hackathon Prize Verifier
ideas.brief: 11-dimension verification on hackathon prizes. Is cash real? Sponsors legit? Feed into hackathonhelp.

ideas.title: Proof-Carrying Agent Identity
ideas.brief: Agent carries verification certificate. Other agents verify: real? capable? trustworthy?

ideas.title: Hackathon Idea Generator
ideas.brief: Append-only event store tracks idea→research→build→deploy. Apply finalbuilds2 experiment framework to hackathon project selection.

ideas.title: Endpoint Factory
ideas.brief: finalbuilds2 monitors which x402 endpoints get traffic, auto-deploys new ones. Observability + experiment tracking for APIs.

ideas.title: SaaS Escape Route API
ideas.brief: Unbundled's return eligibility + plan resolver as x402 endpoints. Real data (USITC HTS API).

ideas.title: Constraint Solver MCP
ideas.brief: Policy DSL evaluator as MCP tool. Given constraints, find best option. Reuse for SaaS plan comparison.

ideas.title: PDF Toolkit x402 API
ideas.brief: OneThing PDF tools (merge/split/sign) as x402-gated API. $0.001/operation. Instant revenue.

ideas.title: Model Router MCP
ideas.brief: dealradar's pick_model as x402 endpoint. Agents pay to find cheapest model for their task.
